create_transformer_config: create a TransformerConfig dataclass instance with embedding dimensions, attention types, and head counts for a Gemma model
init_transformer_cache: initialize a KV cache dictionary for all transformer layers using TransformerConfig.init_cache with batch size and cache length
make_attention_layer_types: build a repeating tuple of attention types for each transformer layer by cycling a pattern across the total number of layers
create_kv_cache_sharing_patterns: generate a list of layer indices mapping shared and unshared layers for KV cache reuse based on attention type and sharing config
configure_kv_cache_sharing: create a KVCacheSharingConfig dataclass to control fraction of shared layers and whether global or local attention layers share caches
